I have one of these, I learned to play a little one handed-jingle on it last night. I havent really played any other instruments since I was a kid so I'm mostly disecting midi's of my favorite songs and trying to play parts of them.
Really cool man! It looks to be a great piece of hardware that you can be really expressive with. How does it feel on the fingers? Does it feel solidly built?

The build quality is excellent, metal face, wooden frame, silicone playing surface, it doesn't feel cheap or plasticy at all. It is a big rectangle so while you can put it on a strap, it is a little awkward to hold that way and play. Your left arm has to do this underhanded chicken wing pose to hit all the notes. If you wear it almost vertical, like a seatbelt in your car, then it could work pretty well but it might look a little silly. Realistically you are probably just going to lay it out flat in front of you.

I'm still trying to adapt to it finger-wise. The chord chart has suggestions but they are all laid out in diagonal lines in this "\" direction which is fine for your right hand but the left is difficult and makes your pinky sore after a while. I think it is more an issue with finding fingerings that are more comfortable for the left hand. I'm sure they exist but since not many people have these things there aren't a lot of teaching materials around. If you aren't trying to hit multiple notes at once then you are pretty much making typing style motions. I have a feeling you could do a lot of really cool stuff once you finger train to hit all the notes that you need.

The per note pitchbend/modwheel control is really cool, I'd like ot be able to increase the slide range for the vertical axis the same way pitch can be done, maybe there is a way to do it.

Great review, thanks for sharing. I was just checking out the website for firmware updates to see what was new and it's nice to see that he's been constantly improving it. I look at the grid and one of the things that comes to mind is sequencing. Granted there are many other controllers that you can sequence with but that would be a really great feature if it could be implemented in the future. Man, what a beast of an instrument. I love the fact that it has polyphonic aftertouch. It's not as common as it should be for instruments in that price range. I'm not a trained musician but I do see myself having a lot of fun and being creative with it. Once again thanks so much for your input on the instrument!
